svg.title: Vantage, explorable 3d artwork
svg.desc: Plate VI. The title VANTAGE, drawn as exact construction geometry: public code, live on GitHub Pages. An axis with four places: Vantage, The Inside, The Edge, The Deep, and an ember travelling along it. Below, five sheets of light seen from the side: from the vantage a line of sight passes through the same point on every sheet and they sum; one step aside, the points no longer line up. Stillness resolves. Motion scatters. Attention pulls.
